impact.text: Because Alice controls the fake service, she can keep it alive indefinitely, permanently blocking Bob from using his instance.

precondition_sources.text: Bob owns an agent instance and intends to register it to a legitimate service.
Alice knows Bob's instance address before it is officially registered.
Alice creates a fake service with minimal bond requirements (e.g., 1 wei).
Bob's agent instance is not yet registered to another service at the time Alice acts.

intent_sources.text: ServiceManager::registerAgents should verify that the caller is the designated operator of each instance being registered, so that only authorized entities can register a given instance.
